title: TikTok Shop Sales Attribution: How to Tie Each Sale to Its Creator Video
summary: Learn how TikTok Shop sales attribution really works — windows, last-touch credit, shop-level reporting — and how to tie each sale to its creator video without spreadsheets.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### How does TikTok Shop sales attribution decide which creator gets credit for a sale?


TikTok Shop sales attribution uses last-content-touch rules: the most recent eligible interaction before an order receives the credit. If one creator introduces a product and another creator's video or link is the final touch before checkout, the later interaction wins the credit, which can understate earlier discovery work.


### What is the default attribution window for TikTok Shop affiliate sales?


The common in-app affiliate defaults are a 7-day click window and a 1-day view window. A shopper who clicks a creator's product link and orders within seven days can earn click-based credit, while a qualifying view must convert within a shorter one-day period. Verify the active rules in your account before comparing campaigns.


### Do livestreams have a longer attribution window on TikTok Shop?


Yes, TikTok Shop's Brand LIVE Impact module attributes eligible sales within 14 days of a viewer interacting with a product card, including conversions on a brand's own website. External affiliate links can also run longer windows than in-app interactions, so check link-specific terms before judging creator performance.


### Why do some TikTok creator videos show no sales credit even when they drove purchases?


TikTok Shop attribution records eligible tracked interactions, not every influence on a buyer's decision. Cross-device shopping, a later creator interaction, or a purchase through another channel like Shopify or Amazon can separate the content that introduced the product from the sale that appears in reports.


### What is shop-level attribution on TikTok Shop?


Shop-level attribution credits an order to a shop's eligible activity through its Shop ID rather than matching every order to a specific product video. A shopper can interact with one product and buy another from the same shop, so shop totals cannot answer every video-level question about which creator earned an order.


### What is affiliate marketing on TikTok?


Affiliate marketing on TikTok lets creators earn commissions by promoting products through tracked links, videos, and livestreams inside TikTok Shop. Credit follows attribution rules, so brands should track interaction type and dates alongside reported credits to set fair expectations for creator commissions.


### Can TikTok be used as a marketing tool for measuring cross-channel sales?


Yes, TikTok works as a marketing channel whose content can lift sales beyond the platform itself. Reacher's Halo Effect tracker measures how TikTok content connects to Amazon, Shopify, and retail sales, giving brands a fuller picture of creator impact than platform-assisted credit alone.
